description: This file is the main entry point for a Flutter application. It defines the root widget 'MyApp' which sets up a MaterialApp with a custom theme and a loading screen widget '_ScaffoldedLoading'. The code initializes the app and shows a basic loading indicator.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the application. Provides a basic MaterialApp with theming and a home loading screen.

classes.name: _ScaffoldedLoading
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays a scaffold with an app bar and a centered loading indicator, representing the app's loading state.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the Flutter application. Calls runApp with MyApp.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method in MyApp and _ScaffoldedLoading that constructs the widget tree.
